what: The times behind the account of what came first in arm64/README.md: the two-kernel smoke run, the dispatch of the three Arm runs, the end of the first measure job of each, and the commit of arm64/PLAN.md. The run and job times were read from the public Actions API (repos/JacoboPacheco/third-of-a-percent/actions/runs/<run> and .../jobs, fields created_at and, for the jobs whose name starts with 'measure', the earliest completed_at) on 2026-10-16; the commit time is the author date of the commit that added arm64/PLAN.md, read with git log --format=%aI -- arm64/PLAN.md in the working repository the project is developed in. That repository is not published and the published repository's history does not contain the commit, so a reader of the published repository can check the run and job times (public Actions runs) and cannot reproduce the plan's commit time. This file is a record of what was read, not a proof. All times are shown in UTC except the commit's own offset. Used by tests/test_readme_numbers.py for the sentences of arm64/README.md that give these times.
